title: Copy Page Title and URL Pro - Copy Links as Markdown, HTML, & Custom Formats
description: The best Chrome extension to copy browser tab titles and URLs simultaneously. Export links as Markdown, HTML, Jira, or custom formats. Perfect for developers, researchers, and writers.
keywords: chrome extension, copy link, markdown copy, url cleaner, productivity tool, notion links, jira format, obsidian citations
ogTitle: Copy Page Title and URL Pro - The Ultimate Copy Tool
ogDescription: Copy smarter, paste faster. The ultimate browser extension for developers and researchers to clean URLs and format links instantly.
schemaDescription: A browser extension that allows you to copy both the title and URL link of a browser tab at the same time, with customizable templates and smart features.
schemaFeatures: Copy title & link, Custom templates, URL cleaning, i18n support

hero.subtitle: The ultimate browser extension for developers and researchers. Clean URLs, format markdown, and streamline your workflow in one click.

templates.title: Templates you write
templates.desc: Placeholders for the title, the URL, its parts, and the text you selected — combined however you like, bound to whichever shortcut you prefer.

privacy.title: Nothing leaves your browser
privacy.desc: No account, no sync, no analytics. Your templates and the pages you copy stay on your machine, and the source is public so you can check.

langs.title: Nine languages
langs.desc: Interface, onboarding and settings are fully localised — including the shortcut labels, which follow each platform's own conventions.

steps.title: How do you save — or share — this page?
steps.desc: You need two things: what it is called, and where it lives. Getting both usually means two trips and a bit of tidying up.

steps.title: Copy the page — or just the part you highlighted
steps.desc: One shortcut takes the title and link. Another wraps whatever you selected, so a quote arrives with its source attached.

steps.title: The clipboard shows you what it took
steps.desc: A confirmation with the actual text in it, so you paste knowing what will land — instead of pasting to find out.

steps.title: Drop it into your notes
steps.desc: Notion, Obsidian, a doc, a ticket, a message. It arrives as a real link, not two lines to clean up.

steps.title: Or any other format you need
steps.desc: Markdown for notes, HTML for a post, Jira syntax for a ticket, or a template you write yourself.

demo.selText: A design system is a contract between design and engineering.

developers.title: For Developers
developers.desc: Copy links for Git commit messages, Jira tickets, or generic Markdown documentation instantly.

writers.title: For Writers
writers.desc: Streamline your citations. Perfect for grabbing links for blog posts, formatted HTML, or newsletter curation.

research.title: For Research
research.desc: Integrates perfectly with Obsidian, Logseq, and Notion to build your second brain faster.

everyone.title: For Everyone
everyone.desc: Share clean links with friends without the ugly ?utm_... tracking parameters attached.

q1.a: Yes, Copy Page Title and URL Pro is open-source and 100% free forever. No hidden subscriptions.
q1.aPlain: Yes, Copy Page Title and URL Pro is open-source and 100% free forever. No hidden subscriptions.

q2.a: Absolutely not. We do not collect, store, or transmit any usage data. Everything happens locally on your browser. See our Privacy Policy.
q2.aPlain: Absolutely not. We do not collect, store, or transmit any usage data. Everything happens locally on your browser. See our Privacy Policy.

q3.q: Can I create my own formats?
q3.a: Yes! You can create unlimited custom templates using placeholders like {title} and {url}.
q3.qPlain: Can I create my own formats?
q3.aPlain: Yes! You can create unlimited custom templates using placeholders like {title} and {url}.

q4.q: Which keyboard shortcuts does it use?
q4.a: Three are set up on install: Ctrl+Shift+P for the title and URL, Ctrl+Shift+L for a Markdown link, and Ctrl+Shift+U to wrap selected text with its source. On macOS these use Command instead of Ctrl. Every one of them can be changed, and you can add your own.
q4.qPlain: Which keyboard shortcuts does it use?
q4.aPlain: Three are set up on install: Ctrl+Shift+P for the title and URL, Ctrl+Shift+L for a Markdown link, and Ctrl+Shift+U to wrap selected text with its source. On macOS these use Command instead of Ctrl. Every one of them can be changed, and you can add your own.

q5.q: Can I copy several tabs at once?
q5.a: Yes. Open the popup and switch to All Tabs, tick the ones you want, and copy them together in whichever template you pick. The free version copies up to five at a time.
q5.qPlain: Can I copy several tabs at once?
q5.aPlain: Yes. Open the popup and switch to All Tabs, tick the ones you want, and copy them together in whichever template you pick. The free version copies up to five at a time.

footer.tagline: Open source productivity for the modern web.

batch.title: Or take several tabs in one go
batch.desc: Finished reading with a stack of tabs open? Pick the ones you want and copy up to five at once, in the format you already use — instead of visiting each to fetch its link.
